intro: Ops enabled: Face 5 (prerequisite, from fresh stock) and 3D Rough (kind adaptive3d, from remaining stock). Scallop Finish and Project Curve disabled. Only clearing_strategy changes between columns.

The links and entries views and the crops come from the exported .nc file. Move i of the op is section line i+1 (the post adds one G0 at each end); the G0-run count equals the narration's retract count in every column, which checks the mapping.
The stock render colours by height (blue low, red high). It does not show deviation from the model.
